justify_why_units_are_missing.justification: x-axes show scatter or fluorescence channel labels (e.g., FSC-A, FSC-H, IgD, Viability) with numeric tick marks but no explicit units (e.g., channel units, 'AU' or similar) in the axis labels or caption.
y-axes show scatter or fluorescence channel labels (e.g., SSC-A, CD4, Fas, IgM) with numeric tick marks but no explicit units (e.g., channel units, 'AU' or similar) in the axis labels or caption.

x-axes are marker or scatter measures (e.g., CD19, IgD, FSC-A) presented with numeric scales but lack explicit units such as fluorescence intensity units or channel counts in the axis labels or caption.
y-axes are marker or scatter measures (e.g., CD98, FSC-A) presented with numeric scales but lack explicit units such as fluorescence intensity units or channel counts in the axis labels or caption.

x-axes show immunophenotyping or binding signals (e.g., IgD, NP, CD138) with log-scale numeric ticks up to 10^6 but no units (e.g., fluorescence intensity in arbitrary units) are specified on the axes or in the caption.
y-axes show immunophenotyping or binding signals (e.g., IgM, Fas, CD38) with numeric/log ticks but no explicit units (e.g., channel counts or 'AU') are provided.
x-axes are marker fluorescence intensities (e.g., CD44, PD-L2) plotted with numeric/log scales but no unit designation (such as 'AU', MFI, or channel units) is given on the axes or in the caption.
y-axes are marker fluorescence intensities (e.g., CD62L, CD80) plotted with numeric/log scales but no unit designation (such as 'AU', MFI, or channel units) is given on the axes or in the caption.

x-axes are marker fluorescence intensities (e.g., CD44, PD-L2) with numeric/log scales but lack explicit units (e.g., arbitrary fluorescence units or channel counts) on the axis labels or in the caption.
